resilience.basis.years: Share of crop-years at this field with no drought, heat or frost in the crop's sensitive months, {years} years ({from}–{to}). The range runs from the 10th to the 90th percentile year.
resilience.basis.missing-months: Share of crop-years at this field with no drought, heat or frost in the crop's sensitive months, {years} years ({from}–{to}). {count} of the {needed} months the crops need are missing from the record and were left out.
soil.basis.rule-range: The range comes from the low and high values given in the source rules.
soil.basis.rule-of-thumb: The source gives a single value, so the range is 15% either side, a rule of thumb.
soil.basis.total: Weighted mean of {indicators} soil health indicators. Not scored: {missing}.
soil.basis.total-complete: Weighted mean of all {indicators} soil health indicators.
soil.basis.compared: Your soil health total plus this rotation's weighted difference from yours on {shared}, the indicators scored for both.
soil.basis.no-indicators: No soil health indicator could be scored: the rule tables are missing.
soil.basis.cover-only: Only soil cover is counted so far: the share of months with a crop, cover crop or residue. Nitrogen, organic matter, erosion and pest break are not scored yet. The range is 15% either side, a rule of thumb.
soil.evidence.nitrogen: {legumeYears} of {years} years carry a legume, about {creditKgPerHa} kg N/ha a year. Leaching loss counted: {leachingLossPct}%.
soil.evidence.nitrogen-no-leaching: {legumeYears} of {years} years carry a legume, about {creditKgPerHa} kg N/ha a year. Nitrate leaching is not counted: no sourced leaching rule.
soil.evidence.organic-matter: Humus balance of {balancePerYear} units a year on this field ({climateClass} climate).
soil.evidence.organic-matter-unadjusted: Humus balance of {balancePerYear} units a year, not adjusted for {adjustments}: no sourced rule.
soil.evidence.erosion: {exposedMonths} bare months per cycle catch about {bareRainMm} mm of rain a year.
soil.evidence.pest-break: {violations} of {years} crops come back before their family's minimum break.
priority.basis.forage: {forageYears} of {years} rotation years give forage: a forage crop or a cover crop that can be grazed. Counted from crop traits.
priority.basis.water: Growing-season rain covered both the crop's seasonal need and the field's evapotranspiration in {coveredYears} of {cropYears} crop-years on this field's NASA POWER record (model estimates). Range: 10th to 90th percentile year.
total.basis: Soil health counts for {soil}%, climate resilience for {climate}%, your priorities for {priorities}% and income for {income}%.
income.not-wired: Income is not calculated yet. Prices and costs are not loaded.
twins.error: Similar fields could not be loaded. The rest of the card is complete.
why.rank.keepSoil: Ranked {rank} of {count} rotations checked when you rank on keeping your soil.
why.rank.improveSoil: Ranked {rank} of {count} rotations checked when you rank on improving your soil.
why.rank.income: Ranked {rank} of {count} rotations checked when you rank on income.
why.current: This is the rotation the field grows now. Every other option is compared with it.
why.history.farmer: Found from the crops you entered for {from}–{to}.
why.history.cropscape: Found from USDA CropScape satellite crop maps for {from}–{to}. These maps are a model estimate, so check them against what you grew.
evidence.history-cropscape: {count} years of crop history come from USDA CropScape crop maps of this field.
why.cover-crop: A {cover} cover crop after the {crop} keeps living roots in the soil after harvest.
why.legume: The {crop} is a legume. It fixes nitrogen that the next crop can use.
why.fewer-bare: The soil is bare about {bare} months a year instead of {currentBare} with your current rotation.
why.more-resilient: {value}% of crop-years on this field's record had no drought, heat or frost in the crops' sensitive months, against {current}% for your current rotation.
why.small-change: It changes only one year of what you grow now.
why.more-families: {families} crop families instead of {currentFamilies} give pests and diseases a longer break.
benefit.living-cover: A crop or cover crop is growing in {living} of the {total} months of the cycle.
benefit.legume-nitrogen: A legume in the rotation adds nitrogen, so the next crop may need less fertiliser.
benefit.fewer-hazard-years: Fewer crop-years hit by drought, heat or frost over the {years} years on record: {value}% came through, against {current}% now.
benefit.family-break: {families} crop families in the cycle break pest and disease cycles.
evidence.resilience: {value}% of crop-years at this field had no drought, heat or frost in the crop's sensitive months, {years} years ({from}–{to}) of NASA POWER data, a model estimate.
evidence.hazard-month: In {hit} of {years} years at this field, {month} crossed the {hazard} threshold while the {crop} was sensitive to it.
evidence.water: In the growing seasons checked, this field got {rain} mm of rain on average and lost {et} mm to evapotranspiration (NASA POWER, model estimates).
evidence.cover-months: In each {total}-month cycle the crop calendar shows {bare} bare months and {living} months with a living crop or cover crop. Our calculation from crop calendars.
gap.weak.soil-cover-only: Low confidence: soil health counts only soil cover so far. Nitrogen, organic matter, erosion and pest break are not scored yet.
gap.weak.soil: Low confidence in the soil health score: two or more of its inputs or rules are missing.
gap.weak.climate-record: Low confidence in climate resilience: more than one month in ten that the crops need is missing from the climate record.
gap.current-not-suitable: Your current rotation has {crop}, which FAO GAEZ rates not suitable here (index {index} of 100). It is kept for comparison.
gap.not-suitable: {cropName} was left out: not suitable here according to FAO GAEZ (index {index} of 100).
gap.suitability-unknown: FAO GAEZ has no suitability value for {crop} at this field, so it was not checked.
gap.suitability-error: FAO GAEZ suitability could not be loaded, so no crop was checked for suitability.
gap.rule-missing: Not scored for this rotation: {indicator}. No sourced rule covers every crop in it yet.
gap.soil-compared-shared: This rotation is not scored on the same soil indicators as yours. Its soil health total is your total plus its weighted difference from yours on {shared}, the indicators scored for both, so the two totals can be compared.
gap.soil-compared-none: This rotation shares no soil indicator with yours, so its soil health total cannot be compared with yours.
gap.humus-medium-class: Organic matter uses the coefficients for medium soil. Your soil class may differ.
gap.erosion-rye-row: For the cereal rye cover, erosion uses the soil loss rate for maize sown without tillage into a rye cover.
gap.leaching-not-counted: Nitrogen does not count nitrate lost to leaching in bare months. No sourced leaching rule yet.
gap.erosion-annual-c: Erosion for {crop} uses one yearly soil cover value from the Polish USLE model (IUNG-PIB), not values by crop stage, so its months are less exact.
gap.erosion-no-row: Erosion is not scored for this rotation: no sourced soil cover value (C factor) for {crop}.
gap.humus-not-adjusted: Organic matter is not adjusted for {adjustments}. No sourced rule yet.
gap.unknown-crop: Your crop history has {crop}, which is not in our crop list. Those years were left out of your current rotation.
gap.soil-missing: Soil data is missing for: {inputs}. Scores that use soil texture or organic carbon leave it out.
gap.slope-missing: The field's slope is missing, so erosion does not account for it.
gap.priority-not-scored: Your {priority} priority is not scored yet, so it does not change the ranking.
gap.income-not-wired: Income is not compared yet. Prices, costs and payments are not loaded.
gap.not-checked: Not checked by this tool: drainage, weed pressure and herbicide history, local pests and diseases, and your machinery and contracts.
empty.outside-coverage: Rotations are only compared for fields in the USA and Poland. The climate profile above still applies to this field.
empty.no-history: Enter the crops of the last two or three years to see rotations for this field.
empty.crops-error: The crop list could not be loaded, so no rotations were compared. Try again.
empty.unknown-crops: Your crop history has crops we cannot score yet ({crops}), and fewer than two known years remain. Correct the crops to see rotations.
empty.current-not-scored: Your current rotation could not be scored against this field's climate record, so no rotations were compared.
empty.rules-missing: The rule tables did not load, so no rotations were compared. The climate profile above still applies.
risk.local-pests: Check local pest and disease pressure with your advisor. This tool does not see it.
risk.new-crop: New on this field: {crop}. Check machinery, storage, seed and a buyer before you commit.
risk.herbicide-carryover: Check the labels of herbicides used in the last two years for carry-over limits on the new crops.
risk.cover-termination: Plan how and when you end the {cover} cover crop, so it does not take water or nitrogen from the next crop.
risk.perennial-establishment: The {crop} needs a good first year to establish. Check seedbed, soil pH and how you will harvest or sell it.
risk.bare-months: The soil is bare {bare} of {total} months. Check fields with slopes or poor drainage for runoff in those months.
income.basis.replay: What this rotation would have earned on this field over {years} past years at today's prices. Good and bad years follow this field's weather record, and the average year matches the recent average harvest. Not a forecast.
income.no-price: No sourced price, yield or direct costs for {crop}, so income is not estimated for this rotation.
income.no-yield-response: No yield response factor for {crop}, so its yield in dry years cannot be replayed.
income.no-climate-years: The climate record has no year in which every crop of this rotation could be checked, so income is not estimated.
income.total-loss-every-year: Every past year is a total loss for {crop} under its hazard checks, so its income cannot be replayed for this rotation.
gap.income-calibration-large: {crop}: the hazard checks find much more loss than the recent harvests show, so each replayed year is scaled up {factor} times to match the recent average harvest. Its good years may look better than this field has seen. Check them locally.
income.cover-no-revenue: {crop} earns nothing directly. It pays back through the soil health scores.
income.error: Prices and costs could not be loaded from {source}, so income is not estimated.
income.current-missing: Your current rotation has no income estimate, so there is nothing to compare this income with.
gap.payment-unconfirmed: {programme}: the rate for this campaign could not be confirmed, so it is left out of the income.
gap.payment-no-rate: {programme}: no sourced rate per hectare, so it is left out of the income.
gap.income-ky-borrowed: {crop}: no source gives its own yield response to water, so the dry-year replay uses the {from} value (FAO Paper 66, Table 1).
gap.income-years-left-out: {count} of {years} past years had missing climate data and were left out of the income replay.
gap.cover-cost-missing: No sourced seed and sowing cost for {crop}, so its cost is left out of the income.
gap.crop-after-itself-not-priced: {crop} follows {crop} in this rotation. A crop grown after itself may yield less and cost more than after another crop. The income does not count that: there is no sourced cost or yield for it yet.
gap.payments-error: Payments could not be loaded from {source}, so the income is the margin alone.
gap.payments-not-loaded: Payments are not loaded yet, so the income is the margin alone.
